research_question: With model, query, start node, and asymmetric topology held fixed, does a relation intervention that changes a reachable target's incoming relation-message input multiset change the official G-reasoner output beyond repeat noise?
hypothesis: At least one of A2 (paired relation-ID swap on distinct endpoints) or A3 (equal-norm row transformation for relation rows 0 and 3) changes output by more than epsilon, while metadata-only A1 and semantic ID/row relabel A4 remain within epsilon.
experiment_tier: synthetic mechanism-identifiability gate; exploratory and not main-line SQL evidence

stopping_rule.pass: CPU Gate 0 passes; all 8 outputs are finite with shape [1,5]; A1 and A4 max_abs <= epsilon; A2 or A3 max_abs > epsilon.
stopping_rule.no_go: All validity and negative-control gates pass, but both A2 and A3 max_abs <= epsilon.
stopping_rule.stop_invalid: Any CPU preflight failure, failed A4 invariance, changed checkpoint/fixture, non-finite or wrong-shaped output, resource overrun, or execution failure. No retry in this run ID.
